outcome: Vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC) success
cohort: 490 women carrying a singleton, term, cephalic-presenting fetus, with a previous low transverse cesarean delivery, who opted for a trial of VBAC at a single university-affiliated medical center in Israel
finding: The Maternal Fetal Medicine Unit's (MFMU) VBAC calculator underperformed in predicting VBAC success in an Israeli cohort, and an improved model incorporating additional variables, such as previous VBAC, prior vaginal delivery, spontaneous onset of delivery, and maternal diabetes, showed improved prediction performance.
